messages:
Ada Moreno: manager emailed asking what "counts" as promo evidence for a Staff-level move (IC->Staff). also needs to know how to express the new comp when employee is on a local contract in Mexico (MXN) and we usually budget in USD. any quick guidance?
Samir Desai: keep promo evidence tight: 1-page bullets mapping to rubric + 2 manager paragraphs that call out scope, decision ownership, and org-level impact. attach 2 artifacts (PR links, dashboards). For MX: submit comp-change in MXN, include USD equivalent and FX note.
Jules Park: can the 1-page be a table? manager prefers structure.
Samir Desai: yes a 2-column bulleted table is fine: "Before" / "After" bullets with metrics. Avoid long prose.
Ada Moreno: retro window question: if packet delayed and effective date was 6 months ago, what happens?
Samir Desai: standard lookback = 120 days. exceptions up to 270 days need VP approval + comp ops signoff. Large retro (> $12k USD) triggers finance review. Put an estimated USD retro in the ticket to speed it up.
Jules Park: payroll specifics for MX? manager wants to budget in USD for hiring approval.
payroll-bot: Payroll: we convert MXN -> USD using payroll FX table on the effective date. Provide both MXN and USD estimates in the Workday ticket. If retro spans two countries, payroll splits payment and applies local withholding. Cutoff: 10th of month for MX payroll run.
Ada Moreno: who nudges the employee on tax docs / KYC? manager or people-ops?
payroll-bot: Manager should request docs via Workday. people-ops will follow up if missing during ticket intake.
Samir Desai: pasteable checklist for manager:
```
- Attach Promo evidence (1-page bullets + 2 manager paragraphs)
- Add 2 supporting artifacts (PR link, dashboard snapshot)
- Submit comp-change in MXN and include USD equivalent
- Include estimated retro (USD) and reason for delay
- Confirm employee uploaded tax/KYC in Workday
- Tag @payroll-bot and @people-ops-bot
- If retro > $12k or lookback >120 days, request VP signoff
```
Ada Moreno: perfect  i'll pass this to the manager and ask for the artifacts today. thanks :pray:
people-ops-bot: Promo evidence template v3 uploaded to #people-ops-resources (doc ID T-3312).
